name: Compressor

failures: #8 action singularity — selected preset card AND primary export button are both fully-saturated coral, competing in one narrow column
#10 UI contrast — muted unselected preset icons (mid-gray on ~#434343) likely dip below the 3:1 non-text floor
native#1 lineage — custom design language, Lucide-class line icons, non-native controls; not clearly AppKit
native#3 selection grammar — solid brand-colour fill, not native inset accent-tinted fill with accent glyph
native#5 density — oversized touch-adjacent targets, not 20-28pt native control tier
native#6 accent binding — hardcoded brand coral, not the user's system accent
n/a: #4/#5/#6 (icon-only UI, no body text), #12/#13 (no inputs/labels), #14 (static render, no focus state), native#4/#8/#9 (no sidebar/toolbar; concentricity unverifiable in perspective)

tokens.notes: Brand hue, not a system accent; not in macOS-27 12-hue palette (between Red #FF4245 and Orange #FF9230). Same coral used in marketing type.
Dark mode avoids pure black; darks marginally warm.

tokens.value: solid coral #EA5A48 + white glyph + white dot
tokens.notes: Selection = full saturated brand fill (non-native grammar).
Preset cards + primary button, generous soft radius.
Slider knob, cards, primary button far exceed native 20-28pt tier.
Unselected preset icons; risks <3:1 non-text floor.

patterns.key_values: right control column ~35-40% width, three 1px-divided sections: quality slider (coral track + tick scale) / 3-up radio preset cards / one full-width primary button
3-up equal-width radio preset cards (leaf/scale/diamond), exclusive selection via bottom dot indicator + solid-coral fill on active
left zone = full-height edge-to-edge image preview with small corner image-badge glyph overlay

signature_moves: Physical-metaphor preset trio: leaf (eco/max-compression) -> balance scale (balanced, selected) -> diamond (best quality) encodes an abstract quality-vs-filesize dial as three familiar objects instead of numbers/words (picture-superiority + trained schemas)

The unifying coral: one warm brand hue (#EA5A48) carries both the marketing wordmark's tagline and every active UI element (slider fill, selected card, primary button) so app and poster read as one object
defects: Focal Collision (soft) — selected preset card + primary export button both fully-saturated coral, two focal points competing in one column
Recognition-over-recall violation — icon-only presets and export button carry no text labels; users must infer meanings (Jakob's Law / Weinschenk)
Non-native selection & accent grammar — solid brand-fill selection + hardcoded brand accent instead of system-accent-bound inset tint (native-tells #3/#6)
Contrast Dilution (borderline) — muted unselected preset icons risk dropping below the 3:1 non-text floor

aesthetic.direction: Warmed neo-grotesque product / consumer-utility dark: dark warm-charcoal neutral ramp + one non-electric accent (coral instead of the usual electric blue), heavy grotesk wordmark
peers: ImageOptim's spirit but far more designed

psychology: Hick's Law — reduces the quality/size decision to 3 named presets + one fine slider; choice cut at the decision point (well used)
Von Restorff / signal-detection — single saturated coral primary button is the one different thing drawing the eye to Export (slightly diluted by the equally-saturated selected card)
Jakob's Law / recognition-over-recall — VIOLATED: icon-only presets force inference of leaf/scale/diamond meanings
Picture superiority + schemas (Weinschenk) — object metaphors (scale=balance, diamond=premium) convey the abstract tradeoff faster than text
Aesthetic-usability effect — polished warm-dark composite raises perceived usability/trust on first contact
Fitts's Law — oversized targets make every control trivial to hit (arguably over-applied for a pointer-first desktop app)
notes: Evidence is a SINGLE marketing composite: app window in ~15-20deg perspective under studio lighting, no orthographic screenshot, no visible menu bar, almost no body text (icon-only UI). ALL metrics estimated + low-confidence; colours carry lighting bias. Lineage genuinely undecidable from one perspective render — native window frame (real traffic lights, centered title, native radius) wrapping a custom non-native-grammar body; could be heavily-styled SwiftUI or Electron. Per the lineage gate, this app's selection/accent/density evidence must NOT feed macOS canon regardless. Icon (icon.png, 598x598) present in source but out of scope for this Workflow-A UI digest. Task was Workflow A only; ledger/patterns/TASTE untouched by design.
